I answered Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had reported duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. Marcus is a member of that channel. The duplicates were the same trailer logged twice at 06:30: the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him manually. Dana said they would follow up on it. The "Director of Yard Operations" title comes from the team's notes, not from the channel.

The same message also mentioned a seat-count change. I left it out of the reply because Marcus didn't ask about it.
